verdict.rationale: Navan documents its own receipt scanning for expenses (navan-docs-24) and policy-based flagging of transactions. Users can query those flags and violations through Ava or the MCP (navan-docs-5, navan-docs-6, navan-docs-19, navan-docs-22), which partly covers reading receipts and auditing against policy. Nothing shows AI automatically coding expenses, suggesting categories or memos, or detecting duplicates or fraud, and the flagging is not shown to be AI-driven. Missing for 10: AI auto-categorization/GL coding, memo suggestions, duplicate detection, fraud detection, evidence that receipt reading is AI extraction that populates expense fields, independent corroboration.
